cases.title: Robin boundary block encoding at N=8
cases.semanticTier: Exact primitive source reproductions and certified same-tier winner
cases.problem: For the fixed homogeneous-Robin fourth-derivative discretization with N=8, construct an exact logical unitary whose clean block is the scaled non-unitary matrix A.
cases.contract: Lean proves three exact primitive block encodings under one frozen convention: the padded paper-seven normal form, a fixed-N8 and f=1 standard-RY-corrected realization of Figure 4, and the evolved XOR four-slot candidate. It then proves the XOR route strictly better than both source realizations in lexicographic order (gate count, depth, auxiliary qubits, oracle calls). Qiskit and OpenQASM replay all three gate lists; they do not replace the Lean equalities.

the integer matrix used by the exact decomposition proofs
the exact high-level unitary and clean block are proved; named loaders and SELECT operations may remain logical stages
every logical stage is expanded into the frozen exact basis {X, RY(theta), RZ(theta), CX}, and Lean proves that the primitive product equals the T2 unitary

circuit.registers: Each route declares its own wire order; all use exact {X, RY(theta), RZ(theta), CX} gates and clean workspaces

evolution.caption: All scored points below use the same exact primitive basis, normalizer 56/3, zero error, all-to-all connectivity, little-endian indexing, clean workspaces, and score order (gates, depth, auxiliary qubits, oracle calls). The comparison is benchmark- and compiler-specific, not a global optimality theorem.
evolution.scoreAudit: The paper's numerical experiment counts undecomposed multi-controlled rotations as instructions, whereas ASPBE counts the exact {X, RY, RZ, CX} list after a frozen compiler. These tiers are not compared numerically. Within the ASPBE primitive tier, the XOR route has fewer gates, lower depth, and fewer auxiliary qubits than both baselines; all oracle counts are zero. It therefore wins under every ordering of these four coordinates, not only the displayed lexicographic order.

sourceInterpretation: The historical split-seven weighted-permutation LCU is retained as structural evidence, but it is not a sparse-access enumeration because two nonzero slots can address the same entry.
Bulk rows of D and bulk rows of D-transpose are different tests. The Figure-4 indicator acts on D-transpose and therefore selects source columns 3 and 4.
Equation (27) has a missing factor-of-two typo: the standard Qiskit and ASPBE RY convention needs 2 arccos(c) to place c in the clean matrix entry.
The literal gamma-1 intermediate normalization is not inferred from gates that precede it; the certified route proves the executable stage states instead.
Dirty-workspace behavior is the actual reversible extension produced by the compiler. Only the declared clean projection is the block-encoding contract.
The coefficient function is f=1 in this fixed benchmark, so its oracle is proved equal to identity and constant-folded.

qiskit.role: Regenerates three separate canonical artifacts: the XOR candidate at the task root, paper-seven under paper-seven/, and the fixed-N8 Figure-4 realization under figure4-fixed-n8/. Each receives an internal matrix check, gate-by-gate Qiskit Operator check, and strict OpenQASM 3 round-trip.
